medium.technique: Digital ink and vector illustration with flat color fills
marks: A uniform black monoline outlines the jaw, chin, and closed eyelids without line weight variation.
A thin, semi-translucent purple ribbon stroke loops in loose serpentine curves upward from the candle wick into the nostril.
Fine multi-colored strokes in cyan, yellow, pink, and mint green pack the black silhouette with small dots, rings, and hatchings.
A solid, unmodulated lilac-purple background fill covers the entire perimeter with zero visible tooth or grain.
Thick, solid pitch-black shape fill defines the scalloped, multi-pointed perimeter of the hair mass.
medium.surface: Digital plane rendered as a flat, untextured periwinkle field across more than seventy percent of the frame
medium.edges: Crisp, razor-sharp hard contours defining all silhouettes and internal linework
medium.density: Extremely dense, labyrinthine mark-making within the spiky crown; totally vacant across the surrounding periwinkle perimeter
medium.as_material: Opaque silkscreen enamel printed over a matte cardstock ground

measured.role: deep charcoal contour and mass undertones
mid-value shadow on smoke and candle glass
bright lime and mint green graphic accents
pale lavender highlights on the candle and brow

palette.value_structure: A high-key background contrasts directly against an intensely dark, low-key silhouette anchored in the upper half. The darkest black fills the starburst hair mass, while the lightest value is the pale periwinkle ground showing throughout the perimeter.
palette.temperature: Cool overall due to the expansive periwinkle field, punctuated by small electric warm yellows and greens inside the dark crown.
palette.lighting: No directional light source; entirely graphic flat-field illumination with localized linear contrast.

subject.what: A disembodied human face floating above a small glass candle, with sprawling psychedelic imagery erupting from the hair
subject.doing: Resting with closed eyes while inhaling a thin tendril of candle smoke into the nose
subject.pose: Head held level and front-facing, suspended vertically above a tabletop candle jar
subject.expression: Placid, meditative serenity indicated by resting eyelids, downward lashes, and a slight closed smile
subject.stylisation: Minimalist comic-book facial linework paired with dense, cartoonish doodle iconography inside a spiky silhouette

story.nature: A sensory mystic or dream traveler whose consciousness expands into miniature worlds upon inhaling aromatic smoke
story.habitat: A quiet domestic meditation alcove or altar space secluded from ambient noise
story.implies: The candle was recently ignited, and the inhaled vapor has triggered an instantaneous mental bloom
story.world: Apothecary glass containers, matchsticks, dried lavender bundles, and ritual oils

composition.mass: Concentrated in the upper-middle region where the multi-pointed black hair spreads outward, balanced by the small anchor of the candle at bottom center

flow_lines.line: translucent smoke trail rising from the wick to the nostrils
vertical median passing through the candle, nose, and third eye
scalloped jagged contours radiating outward along the hair perimeter

composition.negative_space: Unbroken periwinkle ground filling all four margins, comprising roughly 72 percent of the total canvas area
composition.symmetry: Strong bilateral symmetry along the vertical axis in overall silhouette, broken by chaotic asymmetrical doodles internally
composition.scale_cues: The standard glass candle jar at the base establishes the head as roughly life-sized

focal.what: The open third eye rendered in black and white directly on the center of the forehead

composition.frame: Uncropped subject floating freely with wide margins on all four sides

energy.why: The complete physical stillness of the resting face is contradicted only by the energetic, teeming complexity of neon symbols locked inside the black crown.

details.what: A frontally placed third eye surrounded by flame-like black tendrils
details.where: Forehead center, just above the bridge of the nose
details.why: It acts as the visual origin point where the candle smoke enters and explodes into the hair

details.what: Spotted psychedelic mushrooms and double helix strands drawn in mint green and violet
details.where: Left and right lobes of the black silhouette
details.why: They introduce organic and biochemical motifs directly into the psychic field

details.what: A glass candle tumbler bearing an eye motif on its paper label
details.why: It grounds the visionary event in a domestic, mundane object

unlike: Unlike traditional depictions of meditation or psychedelic visions that blur and dissolve the background, this work confines the entire hallucinatory explosion inside a sharp-edged silhouette against an unbroken, sterile field of periwinkle.
